population_rule: Identify every procurador/procuradora from primary procedural material and pair them by represented party, lawyer, proceeding and period. Never infer a permanent lawyer-procurador pairing.

denominator_status.meaning_of_zero: No procurador name is promoted into this register until recovered and verified from the procedural corpus. Zero here is not evidence that no procuradores acted.
denominator_status.next_action: Scan pleadings, LexNET receipts, poderes, apud acta, notifications, autos, providencias, diligencias, decretos and appeals across every connected proceeding.
